headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback to edge out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In another close matchup, the Pirates secured a 3-2 victory over the Brewers, with Yohan Ramírez earning the win and Mason Montgomery notching the save. The Minnesota Twins took down the Los Angeles Angels 5-3, with Royce Lewis leading the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. The Atlanta Braves have placed left fielder Mike Yastrzemski on the 10-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. The Minnesota Twins transferred LHP Anthony Banda from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left lat strain. The Athletics placed 1B Nick Kurtz on the 10-day injured list retroactive to July 10, 2026, with a right thumb capsule sprain. The Milwaukee Brewers placed LHP Kyle Harrison on the 15-day injured list retroactive to July 9, 2026, with left forearm tightness.

The Chicago White Sox made a midseason trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The Minnesota Twins acquired RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.
